query:
Both Claudette and Vera expressed concern about parking in relation to the no. 22 planning application. Who was specifically concerned about parking being blocked during construction works, and who was opposed to the development on character grounds?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Vera, episodic, t0 @2025-05-05T18:52:00) Already sent mine to the council. Main concerns: scaffolding access, parking disruption during works.
[2] (about=Claudette, episodic, t0 @2025-05-05T11:17:00) I saw it this morning. I remember when no. 22 was a single-storey cottage. This street does not need any more bulk added to it. I shall be objecting.
[3] (about=Claudette, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) opposes the £80 annual resident parking permit scheme, sees it as an additional burden on residents who previously parked freely
[4] (about=Claudette, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) could accept a trial period for the parking scheme, but not permanence
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Claudette, group-interaction, t4 @2025-05-19T08:53:00) the joint note will include the driveway at no. 19, which has been a problem corner for months
[6] (about=Femi, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) broadly in favour of the parking scheme, concerned about commuter overflow onto the next street
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Femi, group-interaction, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) group will represent the range of views on the parking scheme at the consultation meeting: Vera and Marcus in favour, Claudette against, Jordan neutral, Femi broadly yes with caveats
[8] (about=Jordan, core, t0 @2025-05-05T11:04:00) rents the property, not personally invested in the planning issue
[9] (about=Jordan, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) neutral on the parking scheme as he has no car, but thinks £80 is steep
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jordan, group-interaction, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) group would want a review after a year if the parking scheme is implemented
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) in favour of the resident parking permit scheme, believes it would fix the school gate pavement parking problem
[12] (about=Marcus, core, t3 @2025-05-19T08:47:00) will formally raise the near-miss incident at the school gate with a car reversing off no. 19's driveway, where his son was nearly hit
[13] (about=Vera, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) supports the parking scheme because home visits require parking on clinic days
[14] (about=Vera, core, t0 @2025-05-05T11:04:00) already sent individual objection to council, main concerns are scaffolding access and parking disruption
agent_answer:
Vera — concerned about parking disruption / being blocked during construction works (Option D).

Claudette — opposed to the development on character grounds, saying the street “does not need any more bulk added to it” (Option A).
